India’s Oscar Entry ‘Gondhal’ Debuts Global Trailer as Awards Campaign Intensifies

28 Oct 2026, 06:29 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: variety.com

1 min read

Key takeaways

A New Vision for Indian Cinema

The Marathi-language thriller *Gondhal*, India’s official submission for the 99th Academy Awards’ international feature category, has released its global trailer. Directed by Santosh Davakhar, the film marks his feature debut and was selected from 33 national contenders.

Plot and Production

Set in rural Maharashtra, the story unfolds during a traditional Gondhal ritual. It follows Suman (Ishita Deshmukh) as she navigates a restrictive marriage and a high-stakes relationship with her lover, Sarjerao (Nishad Bhoir). The production features an opening 25-minute unbroken take and a score by composer Ilaiyaraaja.

Reception and Context

Winner of the Silver Peacock for best director at the 56th International Film Festival of India, the film has been described by jury members as a "Shakespearean fable." Viewers can follow the film's progress through the official trailer available via Variety.
